note: DT.1e: every known-2xx / unknown-status JSON write and every JSON bind in a Go handler (gin, echo, fiber, net/http encoding/json, chi render) is one MESSAGE_TYPE cell (code-domain wire::ServerWire, window site) on the handler, its value classified as written: a call chain (self. for the receiver), a type, a field chain, an envelope's keys, an inline struct; a local is replaced by its declaration (`v, ok := f.store.Vehicle(..)` -> the call; `var req models.RegisterVehicle` -> the type). The receiver must be typed by the framework's Context / Ctx through this file's import. A non-2xx write (the 404 Problem, the 400 gin.H error) is skipped by its STATUS, never by key name. DT.1f: the Go build types each value to its in-repo STRUCT (a written type through the file's imports, a call through its callee's declared result or NavFact::SliceResult, a field chain), writes `model` (and the top-level `type`) into the cell, and draws handler -USES-> STRUCT per (handler, struct, form), EVIDENCE graph:go_wire rule json_response / json_bind; a 404 body never reaches a cell, so it draws no edge.
